A student investigates the reaction of small pieces of calcium carbonate with dilute hydrochloric acid.
The hydrochloric acid is in excess.
CaCO3  +  2HCl→  CaCl2  +  CO2  +  H2O
The rate of reaction is found by measuring the volume of carbon dioxide gas produced as time
increases.
The results are shown on the graph.

dilute hydrochloric acid.
All other conditions stay the same.

....................................................................................................................................................

parts.text:

Calculate the mass of calcium carbonate needed to produce 100 cm3 of carbon dioxide gas.
 
mass of calcium carbonate = .............................. g  [1]
